system.description:
You coat your mind in a chakra designed to be malleable and reflect change well. When you would gain a mental or sensory condition you can bounce it back to any hostile creature within range.

Target creature must make an Intelligence saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature gains whatever Mental or Sensory conditions you would gain as if they failed their own saving throw.

Critical Failure: Affected creature suffers the same effects of a Failure, and also cannot remove the condition themselves and instead must spend an action to remake this jutsu’s saving throw to end them.
